title: StegSeed Actor
description: A unified representation of an actor capable of substantiating transitions: human, ai_entity, system, or physical_device.

actor_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the actor (stable). Examples: human.rigel, ai.stegverse.ga-1, device.plantA.sensor-22.

key_refs.description: Optional references to public keys or cert chains used for signatures.

home_realm.description: Optional governance realm / org / jurisdiction in which this actor is primarily registered.

attributes.description: Optional actor attributes used by admissibility (non-sensitive, non-secret).
